## Class Boundary / Class Instrument

For a bug fix: which class of inputs does this close, and which neighbouring ones does it deliberately not, and why? Name the class instrument — the exhaustive matrix or generator that ranges over that class — and say which of its cells were red before the fix. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) § Bugs: the class, not the instance.
